notes.title: Our next game, Parallel Experiment, launches on March 6, 2025!
notes.content:
We’re beyond excited to share that our next game, Parallel Experiment, will be launching on March 6, 2025! This game is truly special, and we’re incredibly proud of what we’ve achieved. While we’re still ironing out some final details and polishing the game, we’re thrilled to announce the launch date!

[h2]Watch our new trailer[/h2]

Check out our new trailer showcasing a glimpse of what we’ve prepared for you: [previewyoutube=N8Q1urx_6DQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's the story?[/h2]

After getting tricked by the Cryptic Killer in Unboxing the Cryptic Killer, detectives Old Dog and Ally are back on the quest to capture the criminal. A series of cryptic clues leads them across the city, taking them closer to uncovering his grand scheme: the Parallel Experiment. While the detectives are uncertain about the Cryptic Killer's exact plans, they know they must act fast to stop him. One question remains: Are they closing in on the Cryptic Killer, or walking into yet another one of his traps?

[h2]Parallel Experiment in numbers[/h2]

[b]Over 10 hours of gameplay[/b]
No fillers - every moment has a purpose.

[b]5 huge sections[/b]
Each section is bigger than our entire previous game, Unboxing the Cryptic Killer, and three times as big as Unsolved Case. 

[b]Compelling story[/b]
Told through almost 100 comic book pages and over 10,000 in-game words.

[b]Nearly 80 puzzles[/b]
Carefully crafted to test your puzzle-solving skills.

[b]Optional challenges[/b]
For the extra-observant detectives.

[h2]Wondering why Parallel Experiment took so long to develop?[/h2]

It’s because we’re pushing the boundaries of cooperative puzzle design to deliver a game that delights you with clever design, an intriguing story, unique puzzles, compelling characters, and beautiful comic-book-like graphics.

More importantly, this is a game we wish we could play ourselves. Sadly, we won’t be able to experience it for the first time, but you will. We envy you and are very proud of what we’ve accomplished!

[h2]Support us[/h2]
If you haven’t already, please consider wishlisting the game. Every wishlist helps us tremendously. Thank you!

notes.title: Get Creative for Unboxing the Cryptic Killer Anniversary! Puzzle Design Contest
notes.content:
[h2]Detectives,[/h2]
[h3]As we mark the first anniversary of Unboxing the Cryptic Killer, we reflect on a year filled with intrigue, puzzles, and thrilling detective work. This game not only captured the hearts of mystery enthusiasts around the globe but also helped us to set a new standard for our games. To celebrate this milestone, we're excited to announce the launch of our very first Puzzle Design Contest, inviting our dedicated community to become a part of our game development journey for our upcoming title, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2012320/Parallel_Experiment/]Parallel Experiment[/url].[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42606285/2448217366f94af14c3a9819d9fdc25d5b2abdec.png[/img]

[h1]The Inspiration Behind the Contest[/h1]
[h3]Unboxing the Cryptic Killer has been a phenomenal success thanks to our amazing community of players who have dissected every puzzle and unraveled every mystery with unmatched enthusiasm. What better way to celebrate the first anniversary than by inviting you, our brilliant Detectives, to contribute directly to our next project?[/h3]

[h2]Contest Details[/h2]
[h3]Starting on April 27, 2024, we're challenging you to put your puzzle-solving skills to the test and design a puzzle that could be featured in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2012320/Parallel_Experiment/]Parallel Experiment[/url]. Whether you're a seasoned game designer or a passionate gamer with a flair for challenges, we want to see your creativity shine.[/h3]

[h2]How to Enter:[/h2]
[h3]Submit your original puzzle design via the submission form available [url=https://forms.gle/BHo4v3J8tf1yryiZ8]here[/url]. Please provide a detailed description of your puzzle, along with any diagrams or visuals that help illustrate your concept.[/h3]

[h2]Contest Timeline:[/h2]
[h3]The contest kicks off at 7 PM CET on April 27, 2024, and all submissions must be received by 7 PM CET on May 4, 2024. Make sure to get your entries in on time to be considered![/h3]

[h2]Puzzle Requirements:[/h2]
[h3]Your puzzle design should be creative, original, and challenging. It should fit within the world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2012320/Parallel_Experiment/]Parallel Experiment[/url]. Consider elements like interactivity and the use of innovative mechanics.[/h3]

[h2]Main Focus: Cooperativeness[/h2]
[h3]Theme: A game found in a pub, including any pub specific items or an arcade.
Solution: A code or a series of actions leading to opening a drawer[/h3]

[h2]Prizes:[/h2]
[h3]The winner of the contest will have their puzzle featured in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2012320/Parallel_Experiment/]Parallel Experiment[/url], receive a special mention in the game credits, and be awarded two copies of both Unboxing the Cryptic Killer and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2012320/Parallel_Experiment/]Parallel Experiment[/url] once it comes out. It’s your chance to become a part of gaming history![/h3]

[h2]Selection Process:[/h2]
[h3]Submissions will be judged by our team based on creativity, originality, cooperativeness, and how well they integrate with the themes of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2012320/Parallel_Experiment/]Parallel Experiment[/url]. We're looking for puzzles that are not only clever and challenging but also fit seamlessly into the narrative and gameplay of our upcoming game.[/h3]

[h2]Your Role in Our Creative Process[/h2]
[h3]By entering this contest, you grant us the freedom to modify and adapt your designs to better fit the game environment. While the original concept will always be credited to you, adjustments may be necessary to align with the game's design and balance needs.[/h3]

[h2]Looking Forward[/h2]
[h3]This contest is not just about finding the next great puzzle; it's about celebrating the community that has made Unboxing the Cryptic Killer such a success. We're thrilled to offer this unique opportunity for you to leave your mark on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2012320/Parallel_Experiment/]Parallel Experiment[/url].[/h3]

[h3]Thank you for a fantastic year of puzzles and mystery. We can't wait to see your entries and to continue this adventure together. Good luck, and may the best puzzle designer win!

Stay tuned for more updates, and [url=https://forms.gle/BHo4v3J8tf1yryiZ8]don't forget to submit your designs[/url]!

[i]Cheers!
Eleven Puzzles Team[/i][/h3]

notes.title: Unboxing the Cryptic Killer - Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
Updates:

* Added additional game servers to address location-related connectivity issues.
* Improved UI for selecting the starting level.
* Introduced support for various fullscreen modes.
* Enriched the game with more one-liners from the main characters.

Bug Fixes:

* Resolved a bug on Android where, under certain conditions, the game would crash on level 4.
* Addressed synchronization issues between audio and visuals in the cutscenes.
* Corrected a bug where a picture would briefly flash at the beginning of the intro.
* Fixed an issue where part of a clue was not visible on iPads.
